Welcome

Introduction

i
WelcomePage 2 of 3

Having trouble signing in to the GM Early Years App?

You are not alone, and it is not your fault.

If you have tried before and it did not work, it is often one small detail, like a mobile number that does not match. This guide helps you find it, step by step.

Tip: read this guide on another screen

  • A family member’s phone
  • A computer
  • A printed copy

Then sign in on your own iPhone. Only have your iPhone? Read each step, then do it.

Tap Next when you are ready.

Before you start

How this guide works

Section 1 · How this guide worksPage 1 of 1

You do not need to work out what is wrong. This guide does that with you.

There are 3 stages:

  1. 1Stage 1 · What you needFind your Health Visiting team, then answer 6 quick Yes or No questions.
  2. 2Stage 2 · How to sign inFollow the steps one at a time, with a picture of each screen.
  3. 3Stage 3 · Who can helpIf something is not right, see who to contact and what to do.

The stage you are on is shown at the top of each page, so you always know where you are.

Stage 1 of 3 · What you need

Sign-in check

Section 3 · Sign-in checkPage 1 of 8

Who should answer

The child’s mother or primary carer (the account holder)

Answer 6 quick questions. At the end, you will see what is stopping you and what to do next.

Your App account

  1. 1Is the account for you??
  2. 2Will you sign in yourself??

Your NHS login

  1. 3Do you have NHS login??
  2. 4Can you sign in to NHS login??

Both accounts

  1. 5Do your details match??
  2. 6Has your Activation Link arrived??

Answer Yes or No. It takes about 2 minutes.

Stage 2 of 3 · How to sign in

Signing in to the GM Early Years App

5
Section 4 · Signing inPage 1 of 16

Follow the steps in order. Each step shows the screen you will see.

  1. Get startedSteps 1–3
  2. NHS loginSteps 4–9
  3. GM Early Years AppSteps 10–15

You will need

  • The text message with your Activation Link
  • Your NHS login email address and password
  • Your iPhone, with a mobile signal for text messages

Step 1 of 15 · Get started

Step 1 of 15: Restart your iPhone

Section 4 · Signing inPage 2 of 16
  • Hold the side button and either volume button until you see the slider.
  • Drag the slider to turn off. Wait 15 seconds.
  • Hold the side button until you see the Apple logo.
  • Open Safari to come back to this guide.
iPhone with a Home button?

Hold the side button only, then drag the slider.

Activation Link not received

Section 5 · SupportPage 19 of 35

A new link can be sent to you.

i

The issue

Your Activation Link opens the App sign-in page. It comes by text message.

Who can help

Your Health Visiting team

What to do

  • Check your text messages.
  • Check it went to your own mobile number.
  • Still no link? Contact the team.
What to ask

Accessibility statement · 1 of 4

Accessibility statement

About this guidePage 3 of 8

This statement is for the GM Early Years App iPhone guide, run by the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (GMCA).

We want as many people as possible to be able to use it. You should be able to:

  • zoom in up to 200% without text being cut off
  • use portrait or landscape, and Dark Mode
  • search by typing, or by voice in Safari
  • move between pages with Back and Next, or by swiping
BackContents72 / 77Next
Accessibility statement · 2 of 4

Known issues

About this guidePage 4 of 8

Compliance status

This guide is partially compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA, because of the issues below. It has not yet had a full independent audit.

What may not work well

  • Text does not grow with the iPhone’s Larger Text setting. Zoom with Safari’s aA button instead.
  • Screenshots are pictures, so the text in them cannot be made bigger. Each one has a written description, and every step is also written out.
  • The guide has not yet been tested with people who use screen readers.
BackContents73 / 77Next
Accessibility statement · 3 of 4

Feedback and contact

About this guidePage 5 of 8

If you need this guide in a different format, such as large print, easy read or another language, or you find a problem not listed here, email the GMDP Support Team:

gmdp.support@greatermanchester-ca.gov.uk

We will consider your request and get back to you.

If you are not happy with our reply

The Equality and Human Rights Commission (EHRC) enforces the accessibility regulations. If you are not happy with how we respond, contact the Equality Advisory and Support Service (EASS).

BackContents74 / 77Next
Accessibility statement · 4 of 4

How it was tested

About this guidePage 6 of 8

GMCA is committed to making this guide accessible, in line with the Public Sector Bodies (Websites and Mobile Applications) (No. 2) Accessibility Regulations 2018.

On 20 November 2026 the guide was checked:

  • with an automated tool (axe-core) on every page, in light and Dark Mode
  • on 13 iPhone screen sizes, and at 200% zoom
  • in portrait and landscape

This statement was prepared on 20 November 2026. It will be reviewed by November 2027.

BackContents75 / 77Next
About this guide

Your privacy

About this guidePage 7 of 8

This guide does not collect any information about you.

  • No sign-in, cookies or tracking. NHS login and the App have their own privacy notices.
  • What you type and choose stays on your iPhone. It is cleared when you close the guide.
  • Voice search uses Apple’s speech service, only if you tap the microphone.
  • The website host, GitHub, may keep technical details such as IP addresses, as most websites do.

Questions? Email the GMDP Support Team.
